Location: Jakarta / Lampung / West Java / Sunda Strait
Title: Anak Krakatau eruption
Description: Volcanic ash forced suspension of operations at eight Indonesian airports; ferry operations in the Sunda Strait continued with caution and fishing activity was halted.
Assets / Modes Affected: Airports / air cargo / ferries / fishing
Operational / Trade Impact: Airport closures; flight cancellations; air-cargo interruption; maritime caution

Title: German and Dutch port industrial action
Description: Sequential industrial action affected German ports and was followed by planned stoppages in Rotterdam, Amsterdam and Zeeland.
Assets / Modes Affected: Ports / terminals / vessel handling / inland cargo
Operational / Trade Impact: Vessel delay; terminal handling interruption; cargo backlog and congestion displacement risk

Title: Typhoon Dolphin
Description: Typhoon Dolphin disrupted Okinawa and triggered Chinese port closures, ferry suspensions, vessel clearances, airport shutdowns and rail restrictions ahead of landfall.
Assets / Modes Affected: Ports / shipping / aviation / rail
Operational / Trade Impact: Port closure; vessel clearance; airport closure; flight cancellation; ferry and rail suspension

Location: Simón Bolívar International Airport / La Guaira
Title: Venezuela earthquakes
Description: Two major earthquakes severely damaged airport runways and buildings, closing the country's main airport before partial operations resumed in September.
Assets / Modes Affected: Airport / passenger and cargo aviation
Operational / Trade Impact: Extended airport closure; reduced cargo/passenger capacity; temporary facilities required

Title: FAA extends Port-au-Prince flight restriction
Description: Persistent gang violence and prior attacks on aircraft led the FAA to extend restrictions on U.S. commercial and civil aviation over Port-au-Prince.
Assets / Modes Affected: Airport / aviation / air cargo
Operational / Trade Impact: Commercial aviation access remains constrained; Port-au-Prince continues to be isolated from normal U.S.-linked air service

Title: Haitian workers protest fuel-price shock
Description: More than 1,000 workers protested for higher wages after sharp fuel-price increases, illustrating how energy shocks can feed into labour and transport pressure.
Assets / Modes Affected: Industrial workforce / road movement
Operational / Trade Impact: Potential production and commuting disruption; indicator of labour and cost-of-living pressure

Title: Gang clashes disrupt Port-au-Prince and Varreux operations
Description: Armed clashes brought activity at the Port-au-Prince seaport and Varreux fuel terminal close to a standstill, although the port was not formally closed.
Assets / Modes Affected: Port / fuel terminal / cargo trucking
Operational / Trade Impact: Port and fuel-terminal operations severely constrained; implications for imports, fuel and inland distribution

Title: Glacial collapse destroys China-Nepal trade port
Description: A glacial collapse triggered a massive mudslide that destroyed the Gyirong border crossing and customs infrastructure.
Assets / Modes Affected: Border port / customs / road corridor
Operational / Trade Impact: Cross-border trade route physically destroyed; customs and road access lost

Title: Amazon Prime Air cargo aircraft crash
Description: A Boeing 767 freighter operated by 21 Air for Amazon Prime Air overran the runway, causing fatalities, injuries, fuel leakage and substantial flight disruption.
Assets / Modes Affected: Cargo aircraft / airport / runways
Operational / Trade Impact: Runway disruption; cancellations and delays; cargo-aircraft loss; emergency response

Title: Rhine low-water shipping constraint
Description: Critically low Rhine water levels threatened to halt commercial cargo traffic through the Kaub bottleneck and forced vessels to sail part-loaded.
Assets / Modes Affected: Rhine barges / inland terminals / industrial supply chains
Operational / Trade Impact: Draft restrictions; reduced cargo lift; more voyages required; cargo shifted toward road and rail; Higher inland freight costs; industrial logistics bottlenecks; CMA CGM later imposed an inland emergency fee

Title: Danube near-record low-water disruption
Description: Near-record low Danube water levels stranded or delayed river-cruise vessels and suspended some sightseeing operations in Hungary.
Assets / Modes Affected: Danube navigation / river cruise vessels / passenger terminals
Operational / Trade Impact: Vessels stranded or held in ports; sightseeing services suspended north of Budapest; Passenger-shipping and tourism disruption; reduced operational flexibility on the Danube corridor

Title: Typhoon Bavi regional transport disruption
Description: Typhoon Bavi crossed the western Pacific and made landfall in eastern China after forcing mass evacuations and widespread transport restrictions in Taiwan and the region.
Assets / Modes Affected: Airports / rail / roads / coastal shipping / urban logistics
Operational / Trade Impact: Large-scale flight cancellations; reduced rail service; evacuations and weather restrictions across coastal transport systems; Air-cargo and passenger disruption; potential manufacturing and port-hinterland delays in eastern China and Taiwan

Location: Brisbane / southeast Queensland / northern New South Wales
Title: Cyclone Alfred disrupts Brisbane transport system
Description: Cyclone Alfred prompted closure of Brisbane Airport, suspension of public transport and broad emergency preparations across southeast Queensland and northern New South Wales.
Assets / Modes Affected: Brisbane Airport / airlines / public transport / roads / utilities
Operational / Trade Impact: Airport operations suspended; Qantas flights curtailed; public transport shut; power outages and flood risk; Air-cargo and passenger capacity loss; urban distribution delays and supply-chain disruption around Brisbane

Location: Northern Vietnam / Haiphong / Hong Kong / northern Philippines
Title: Wipha disrupts regional port, airport and rail services
Description: Wipha moved through Hong Kong and southern China before making landfall in northern Vietnam, with port, airport and rail suspensions and severe monsoon flooding in the Philippines.
Assets / Modes Affected: Ports / airports / rail / coastal shipping / urban transport
Operational / Trade Impact: Port and transport services suspended in Vietnam; flight cancellations; flooding and government closures in the Philippines; Regional cargo delay and distribution disruption across South China Sea supply chains

Location: Hong Kong / Guangdong / Shenzhen / Pearl River Delta / Taiwan
Title: Super Typhoon Ragasa disrupts Pearl River Delta
Description: Ragasa brought Hong Kong to a standstill and drove large-scale evacuations and transport restrictions across southern China and Taiwan.
Assets / Modes Affected: Airports / roads / coastal infrastructure / urban logistics / marine approaches
Operational / Trade Impact: Flight disruption, transport shutdowns, storm-surge warnings and widespread closures; Short-term disruption across one of the world's densest manufacturing, logistics and port regions

Title: Storm Amy contributes to Rotterdam vessel backlog
Description: A post-storm vessel queue at Rotterdam remained elevated after Storm Amy, with later labour action adding to the congestion.
Assets / Modes Affected: Container terminals / vessel queues / port approaches
Operational / Trade Impact: Ship queue roughly doubled from normal levels before strike effects became dominant; Container delays and reduced ability to absorb further disruption at Europe's largest port

Title: Argentine maritime strike halts grain-export activity
Description: FESIMAF maritime workers launched a 48-hour strike against labour reform, disrupting loading, unloading, pilot transfers and commercial-vessel services around Rosario.
Assets / Modes Affected: Grain terminals / commercial vessels / pilots / port services
Operational / Trade Impact: Agro-export activity brought close to a standstill and vessel dispatch constrained; Disruption to a major global grain, soybean-oil and soybean-meal export system

Title: Greek seafarers strike halts ferry services
Description: Greek seafarers held a 24-hour strike over crews stranded in the Gulf conflict, halting local ferry services and demanding evacuation protections.
Assets / Modes Affected: Domestic ferry services / passenger and vehicle movements
Operational / Trade Impact: Ferry sailings halted for the duration of the strike; Passenger, vehicle and island-supply movements delayed; labour action tied directly to maritime security risk

Title: Concrete transport strike disrupts semiconductor construction
Description: Around 8,000 ready-mixed concrete transport workers suspended deliveries, halting concrete work at major Samsung and SK Hynix semiconductor expansion sites.
Assets / Modes Affected: Concrete plants / truck delivery / semiconductor construction
Operational / Trade Impact: Concrete deliveries blocked and pouring halted at strategic chip-factory construction sites; Potential schedule slippage for semiconductor capacity expansion if stoppage persisted

Title: Rotterdam lashers strike blocks container handling
Description: All approximately 700 lashers at Rotterdam joined a wage strike, preventing container ships from loading or unloading and expanding a vessel backlog.
Assets / Modes Affected: Container terminals / ship loading and unloading
Operational / Trade Impact: Container loading/unloading effectively halted; vessel queue expanded; Backlogs at Europe's largest port with limited diversion capacity because Antwerp was also disrupted

Title: Antwerp-Bruges harbour pilots disrupt marine traffic
Description: Flemish harbour pilots worked to rule over pension reforms, sharply reducing vessel movements at Antwerp and causing delays, strandings and diversions.
Assets / Modes Affected: Pilotage / port approaches / vessel traffic
Operational / Trade Impact: Antwerp handled only 31 ships on a day when 60-80 was typical; delays spread to Zeebrugge; Reduced gateway capacity and weaker diversion options for congestion at nearby Rotterdam

Title: Genoa and Livorno dockworkers block port access
Description: Dockworkers joined nationwide Gaza-related strikes and protests, blocking roads into Genoa and access at Livorno while broader transport services were disrupted.
Assets / Modes Affected: Port access roads / dock labour / regional rail
Operational / Trade Impact: Port access impeded and some transport services disrupted; Localized cargo and hinterland disruption; demonstration of politically driven port-labour action

Location: Milan / Bologna / Rome / Turin / Genoa / Venice / Naples
Title: Italian national strikes disrupt aviation and rail
Description: A one-day labour action against government budget policy caused dozens of flight cancellations and disrupted train and urban transport services across Italy.
Assets / Modes Affected: Airports / airlines / rail / urban public transport
Operational / Trade Impact: Flight cancellations, train disruption and urban transport delays; Air-cargo and business-travel disruption plus inland logistics friction across multiple Italian hubs

Title: Greek farmer blockades disrupt port and border traffic
Description: Farmers used tractors and trucks in nationwide protests, disrupting operations around Volos port and intermittently restricting border and motorway traffic.
Assets / Modes Affected: Volos port / highways / Bulgaria border crossing
Operational / Trade Impact: Port-area disruption; road queues and intermittent border restrictions; Agricultural, trucking and cross-border cargo delays with potential spillover to regional logistics

Location: Czech-Slovak border crossing / regional border points
Title: Czech and Slovak farmers disrupt border crossing
Description: Farmers from several Central European countries used tractors to disrupt a border crossing while protesting non-EU imports and agricultural policy.
Assets / Modes Affected: Road freight / border crossing
Operational / Trade Impact: Border-crossing operations disrupted and road traffic constrained; Short-duration cross-border trucking friction and agricultural trade disruption

Title: Dover and Portsmouth anti-migrant protests disrupt access
Description: Masked anti-migrant protesters blocked roads around the Port of Dover and later streets in Portsmouth, causing traffic disruption around important Channel ferry access points.
Assets / Modes Affected: Port access roads / ferry passengers and cargo traffic
Operational / Trade Impact: Road access disrupted; ferry passengers delayed; access later restored; Localized friction at the UK's main cross-Channel ferry gateway; no confirmed prolonged port shutdown
